name: VRM_PERF_OBLIG_TEMPLATES_B
description: This table contains information about the performance obligation templates.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the performance obligation template.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_METHOD
columns.description: Specifies whether the obligation is satisfied at a point in time or over time. Values are derived from  ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_METHOD lookup type.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation template is active.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Order in which performance obligation templates will be picked for processing.

columns.name: DERIVE_PDC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to derive the pricing dimension combination from source documents for a performance obligation template.

columns.name: IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation template is in-use and cannot be updated.

columns.name: RESIDUAL_APPROACH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the pricing for the goods or services is variable or missing and the standalone selling price for the resulting performance obligation is estimated using the residual approach. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: The basis used to calculate the ratio of the allocated revenue for performance obligation distributions to their underlying promise detail lines. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOC_BASIS.

columns.name: EXEMPT_FROM_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation created using this template should be exempted from allocation.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date when the template becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date when the template becomes inactive.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Code name of a performance obligation group classification. Values are derived from the ORA_VRM_OBLIG_CLASSIF_CODE lookup type.
